summary: Benchmark 2026-V22 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K to report entry into a material definitive agreement — a Pooling and Servicing Agreement for a commercial mortgage pass-through certificate securitization. The filing describes the issuance of Series 2026-V22 certificates, the appointment of servicers and trustees, and the servicing shift for two whole loans (ONX Industrial Campus and Marriott Savannah Riverfront) between securitization trusts. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, spin-off, rights offering, activist campaign, strategic review, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine current report for a structured finance product — not a special situation.
